form.content:
[text* your-name autocomplete:name placeholder "Your Name"]


    [email* your-email autocomplete:email placeholder "Your Email"] 


    [text* your-subject placeholder "Your Subject"] 


    [textarea your-message x3 placeholder "Your Message"] 

[submit "Submit"]

mail.subject: [_site_title] "[your-subject]"
mail.body:
From: [your-name] [your-email]
Subject: [your-subject]

Message Body:
[your-message]

-- 
This is a notification that a contact form was submitted on your website ([_site_title] [_site_url]).

mail_2.subject: [_site_title] "[your-subject]"
mail_2.body:
Message Body:
[your-message]

-- 
This email is a receipt for your contact form submission on our website ([_site_title] [_site_url]) in which your email address was used. If that was not you, please ignore this message.

messages.mail_sent_ok: Thank you for your message. It has been sent.
messages.mail_sent_ng: There was an error trying to send your message. Please try again later.
messages.validation_error: One or more fields have an error. Please check and try again.
messages.spam: There was an error trying to send your message. Please try again later.
messages.accept_terms: You must accept the terms and conditions before sending your message.
messages.invalid_too_long: This field has a too long input.
messages.invalid_too_short: This field has a too short input.
messages.upload_failed: There was an unknown error uploading the file.
messages.upload_file_type_invalid: You are not allowed to upload files of this type.
messages.upload_file_too_large: The uploaded file is too large.
messages.upload_failed_php_error: There was an error uploading the file.
messages.invalid_date: Please enter a date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
messages.date_too_early: This field has a too early date.
messages.date_too_late: This field has a too late date.
messages.number_too_small: This field has a too small number.
messages.number_too_large: This field has a too large number.
messages.quiz_answer_not_correct: The answer to the quiz is incorrect.
